name: kernels-vision

engine.version: lab test build (cargo test --release), no server binary

tests.bin: gb-model inkling2_vision (the Small's vision tests; golden hashes, batch invariance, real Small pack vs HF reduced digests)

commands: NODE=node-2 LAB_SRC=<engine worktree inkling2-loop-vision> OPS_LINES=200 scripts/ops_dev.sh test inkling2_loop_vision mini_vision
NODE=node-2 LAB_SRC=<engine worktree inkling2-loop-vision> PKG=gb-model OPS_LINES=200 scripts/ops_dev.sh test inkling2_loop_vision mini_vision
NODE=node-2 LAB_SRC=<engine worktree inkling2-loop-vision> PKG=gb-model OPS_LINES=200 TEST_ENV=REXL3_INKLING2_DIR=<the Small's staged pack, read only> scripts/ops_dev.sh test inkling2_vision ''
python testdata/inkling2_loop/vision/fetch_vision_pack.py --out target/vision-ref/visionpack   (the Mac, HTTP range reads of the pinned pack: 842 tensors, 242,863,152 B)

python testdata/inkling2_loop/vision/gen_vision_ref.py --pack target/vision-ref/visionpack --oracle <recipe>/oracle --threads 6   (the Mac; transformers be48e7a0, torch 2.14.1 CPU; regenerates the committed goldens byte for byte)
REXL3_NO_CUDA=1 CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=6 cargo check -p gb-cuda --tests --locked   (the Mac)
REXL3_NO_CUDA=1 cargo test -p gb-model --lib --locked families::inkling2::   (the Mac: 31 passed)
notes: Reference: HF transformers be48e7a0 vision tower in fp32 on the pack's effective weights (EXL3 linears decoded to float64 by oracle/exl3.py, BF16 biases and plain tensors as stored) and the vLLM-normalised pixels the engine feeds (the Small's expected.json gives the same HF pixel digests at fc00b5b3). The gate holds the engine to HF's own bf16 tower against that reference: cosine min >= HF - 0.003, mean >= HF - 3e-4, largest element error over the row rms <= 2x HF's. Encode times are one host-side call (patch upload, launches, sync, download) on a locked 2,200 MHz GPU, one run each, not a benchmark. The Small's real-weights vision test ran against the Small's staged pack, read only (REXL3_INKLING2_DIR); its per-token HF comparison needs a reference directory this lane did not generate, so that run checks HF's reduced digests only (worst relative deviation 0.020 to 0.041) and the exact bits come from the synthetic golden-hash test.
